maya: Quick check — proposing a retro for the S3 cache incident next Tue 10:30-11:15 PT. Who needs to be there? :calendar:
kevin: I can make that. Prefer 10:30. I'll be out 11:30 onwards.
sasha: Works for me. Can we set agenda to include timeline, root causes, action triage? Also want to confirm postmortem doc link: https://docs.internal/redwood/postmortems/s3-cache-incident
lina: I can attend first 30 mins, may have to drop. Assign me action owner for follow-up infra fixes if that's ok.
maya: Agenda draft:
```
1) 5m - quick recap and scope
2) 15m - timeline & root cause
3) 20m - mitigations + owner assignment
4) 10m - rollout & monitoring changes
5) 5m - retro notes + next steps
```
maya: Roles: facilitator @maya, scribe @sasha, timekeeper @kevin. Anyone want to swap?
kevin: happy to timekeep. scribe ok with me swapping? :+1:
sasha: ok I'll scribe. Can someone add prework: add one example regression and any logs to the doc before Monday EOD? :spiral_notepad:
lina: will add infra checklist items. tagging infra-bot below for runbook link
infra-bot: runbook: https://infra.redwood/runbooks/s3-cache-fails (auto)
maya: If you can't attend, leave comments in the doc and mark an owner. We'll record and capture action owners during the meeting. Also propose we triage actions in 48h and close or escalate.
product-liaison: I'll join for the mitigation discussion and can help prioritize user-facing comms.
maya: cool — created event and invite sent. If any scheduling conflicts DM me, otherwise I'll follow up with final agenda Monday morning. :thumbsup:
